policy.basis: Copyright and Related Rights Act NN 111/21, Article 18(3): officially published legal, administrative, and judicial texts (including statutes, regulations, and court decisions) cease to be protected by copyright when published for official public information.
policy.scope: Only the text of the individually identified official act published in the Narodne novine official part, after publication for official public information.
policy.retention_rule: Store a source-bound text fragment from .sl-content .doc. Keep official citation, stable URL, capture date and hashes as factual provenance. Exclude the Narodne novine page shell and unrelated page content.
not_covered: full publisher HTML responses and page-shell text
website design, navigation, interface text, and publisher-authored explanatory material
third-party materials, non-text attachments, images, and logos unless independently reviewed
bulk extraction or reuse of the database as a whole, including any separate database right or technical conditions

retrieval_constraints.individual_official_record_urls: use the stable Narodne novine/ELI record URL, not the metadata API as a full-text endpoint
retrieval_constraints.automated_request_rate: maximum three queries per second per the live Narodne novine data-access page
retrieval_constraints.full_page_response_retention: not in the repository; ignored local response may be used transiently to create the official-text fragment
